title: cli: `os package publish` sends `visibility: org` when --visibility is omitted, so re-publishing a marketplace package silently demotes it to org visibility
body:
Filing gate: ① (a product defect with a named landing spot; class a; `reach:` a public door, measured with the real CLI).
Reader: the triage seat routes it on first touch. The producer is `packages/cli` (`domain:cli`). The consumer route is cloud's, so the fix PR should name objectstack-ai/cloud's seam.
Dedupe: semantic issue search `os package publish visibility default org demotes marketplace package re-publish upsert patches visibility` on objectstack returned 1 unrelated hit (#8443, closed). `publish visibility demoted marketplace org re-publish CLI default upsert` on cloud returned 1 unrelated hit (cloud#1846, closed).

## What is wrong

Code read at the framework pin `4b4ee88f`:
- `packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts` L327–L335 declares `--visibility` as `Flags.string`, with options `private | org | marketplace` and **`default: 'org'`**.
- L521–L525 always sends `visibility: flags.visibility` in the package upsert body. When the user omits the flag, that is the default.

The consumer is objectstack-ai/cloud `POST /api/v1/cloud/packages` (`packages/service-cloud/src/routes/package-publish.ts`, upsert branch). For an EXISTING package it patches visibility whenever the body carries one (`if (body.visibility) patch.visibility = visibility`).

**Effect:** a publisher who re-publishes a new version of a `marketplace` package without repeating `--visibility marketplace` silently demotes the package to `org`, and it leaves the marketplace. Nothing warns them.

reach, measured by the cloud#2465 dev on 2026-09-30:
- The real pinned CLI (`node packages/cli/bin/run.js package publish ARTIFACT --server http://127.0.0.1:PORT --token T`, no `--visibility`) sent the captured body `{"manifest_id":"com.acme.visprobe","display_name":"Vis Probe","visibility":"org"}`.
- An in-process probe of cloud's registered route with that exact body, on a package stored as `marketplace`, answered 200 and stored `org`.

## Fix direction (for the executing lane)

- **Producer first:** the CLI sends `visibility` only when the user passed `--visibility`. The `org` default still applies when a package is created, and the create path stays explicit.
- ⛔ Not a cloud-side guess at which values were "explicit". The route cannot tell a default from a choice.
- Whether cloud should also refuse a silent `marketplace` → other demotion through the upsert is a separate product question, and is not assumed here.
- Acceptance:
  1. Re-publishing without `--visibility` leaves an existing package's visibility unchanged.
  2. Creating a package without the flag still yields `org`.
  3. A CLI test asserts that the upsert body omits `visibility` when the flag is absent.

## Source

cloud#2465 dev report (PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2513, patch round 2), out-of-scope finding. Filed by the `repo:cloud` seat (`repo:cloud#1`, session `session_01YSygzqVmrY31BnZge8KDo6`).

Blocked-by: #20900
